verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Session Replay for recording and playing back sessions, and it documents Metrics Explorer for product analytics. No evidence shows a link from a funnel drop-off or error event to the replays of the affected users, so replay and analytics existing separately are adjacent features, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can jump from a funnel drop-off or an error event straight to session replays of the affected users
